description_en: Queries the progress of an export task
name: DescribeExportInfo

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the export task.
You can obtain this parameter by calling the [ExportRecord](~~ExportRecord~~) operation to initiate an export
parameters.help_zh:
导出任务的ID。
您可以调用[ExportRecord](~~ExportRecord~~)接口发起导出后获取该参数
parameters.name: export_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the member account in the resource directory.
You can obtain this parameter by invoking the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id
